title: Pruning Extensions and Efficiency Trade-Offs for Sustainable Time Series Classification
abstract: arXiv:2604.07953v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Time series classification (TSC) at scale requires balancing predictive performance against resource consumption, which is subject to the given data, model, and hardware. This paper introduces a multi-dimensional evaluation framework that allows for explicitly benchmarking and exploring the resource-versus-quality trade-offs in TSC. To improve efficiency, we present a pruning strategy with bounded error for leading hybrid classifiers - Hydra and Quant - and moreover propose Hydrant, a novel extension that integrates interval representations with random convolutions and dictionary learning. With over 4000 evaluated configurations across 20 MONSTER datasets, 10 methods, and three compute setups, we systematically analyze how model design, hyperparameters, and hardware choices impact practical TSC performance. translated_title: 面向可持续时间序列分类的剪枝扩展与效率权衡
translated_abstract: 大规模时间序列分类需要在预测性能与资源消耗之间取得平衡，而这种平衡取决于给定的数据、模型和硬件。本文提出了一个多维度评估框架，能够对时间序列分类中资源与质量之间的权衡进行显式的基准测试和探索。为了提高效率，我们针对领先的混合分类器 Hydra 和 Quant 提出了一种具有有界误差的剪枝策略，并进一步提出了 Hydrant——一种将区间表示与随机卷积和字典学习相结合的新型扩展方法。通过在 20 个 MONSTER 数据集、10 种方法和三种计算设置上评估超过 4000 种配置，我们系统地分析了模型设计、超参数和硬件选择如何影响实际的时间序列分类性能。我们的结果表明，剪枝能够显著降低能耗高达 70%，同时仅轻微降低预测准确率。
tldr: 本文提出多维度评估框架、有界误差剪枝策略及新型Hydrant分类器扩展，可在时间序列分类任务中实现能耗降低高达70%，而预测精度几乎不受影响。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces a multi-dimensional evaluation framework, a bounded-error pruning strategy for hybrid classifiers, and a novel Hydrant extension, achieving up to 70% energy reduction in time series classification with only marginal accuracy loss.
